items.title: Fix the phone menu (IVR)
items.action: Call tickets are transferred 13.0 times per 100 vs 2.6 for other channels: rewrite the menu choices and confirm the issue with one spoken question before routing.
assumptions: the new menu is as accurate as the other channels' (20% of today's wrong choices remain)

items.title: Cross-train 2 Hindi-speaking agents on payment failure and refund
items.action: Hindi payment failure and refund tickets wait 336 min vs 66 min. Train A09, D11 on payment failure and refund: they already speak Hindi and their shifts cover the hours no trained Hindi speaker works today.
assumptions: training is finished before the period and trained agents work at full speed

items.title: Self-serve instant refund on weekend dinner (Team C)
items.action: Team C is overloaded on weekend dinner. Offer an in-app instant refund for missing item claims on orders up to ₹300 in that window, so these customers need no agent.
assumptions: ASSUMPTION: 60% of eligible customers use self-serve
policy choice: only orders up to ₹300

items.title: Status banner the moment a spike alert fires
items.action: Spikes like payment failure on day 18 come from one cause. When OpsLens raises a live spike alert, show an in-app status banner on that issue for 4 hours, so customers know it is being fixed.
assumptions: ASSUMPTION: 30% of customers who see the banner do not open a ticket

items.title: Kitchen order-check for restaurant cluster 17
items.action: Cluster 17: 24.5% of its tickets are wrong item vs 9.6% elsewhere. Send the partners a quality alert and switch on order-check (packing photo before pickup) for this cluster.
assumptions: ASSUMPTION: 100% of the cluster's extra wrong item tickets go away
